006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Map;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidArgumentFunctionException;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.impl.OperationFunctions;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDayTimeDurationItem;
022import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IIntegerItem;
023import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.INumericItem;
024import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IYearMonthDurationItem;
025import dev.metaschema.core.util.CustomCollectors;
026import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
027import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
028import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
029
030/**
031 * Implements the XPath 3.1
032 * <a href= "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-sum">fn:sum</a>
033 * functions.
034 */
035public final class FnSum {
036  private static final String NAME = "sum";
037
038  @NonNull
039  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_ONE_ARG = IFunction.builder()
040      .name(NAME)
041      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
042      .deterministic()
043      .contextIndependent()
044      .focusIndependent()
045      .argument(IArgument.builder()
046          .name("arg")
047          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
048          .zeroOrMore()
049          .build())
050      .returnType(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
051      .returnOne()
052      .functionHandler(FnSum::executeOneArg)
053      .build();
054
055  @NonNull
056  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_TWO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
057      .name(NAME)
058      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
059      .deterministic()
060      .contextIndependent()
061      .focusIndependent()
062      .argument(IArgument.builder()
063          .name("arg")
064          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
065          .zeroOrMore()
066          .build())
067      .argument(IArgument.builder()
068          .name("zero")
069          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
070          .zeroOrOne()
071          .build())
072      .returnType(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
073      .returnZeroOrOne()
074      .functionHandler(FnSum::executeTwoArg)
075      .build();
076
077  private FnSum() {
078    // disable construction
079  }
080
081  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
082  @NonNull
083  private static ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> executeOneArg(
084      @NonNull IFunction function,
085      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
086      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
087      IItem focus) {
088    ISequence<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> sequence = FunctionUtils.asType(
089        ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
090
091    return ISequence.of(sum(sequence, IIntegerItem.ZERO));
092  }
093
094  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
095  @NonNull
096  private static ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> executeTwoArg(
097      @NonNull IFunction function,
098      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
099      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
100      IItem focus) {
101    ISequence<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> sequence = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
102
103    IAnyAtomicItem zero = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true));
104
105    return ISequence.of(sum(sequence, zero));
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * An implementation of XPath 3.1
110   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-sum">fn:sum</a>.
111   *
112   * @param items
113   *          the items to sum
114   * @param zero
115   *          the value to use if no items are provided, which can be {@code null}
116   * @return the average
117   */
118  @SuppressWarnings({
119      "PMD.CyclomaticComplexity", // ok
120      "unchecked" // safe cast for wildcard type
121  })
122  @Nullable
123  public static IAnyAtomicItem sum(
124      @NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items,
125      @Nullable IAnyAtomicItem zero) {
126    if (items.isEmpty()) {
127      return zero;
128    }
129
130    if (items.size() == 1) {
131      return items.get(0);
132    }
133
134    // tell cpd to start ignoring code - CPD-OFF
135
136    Map<Class<? extends IAnyAtomicItem>, Integer> typeCounts = ISequence
137        .ofCollection((List<IAnyAtomicItem>) items)
138        .countTypes(OperationFunctions.aggregateMathTypes());
139
140    int count = items.size();
141    int dayTimeCount = typeCounts.getOrDefault(IDayTimeDurationItem.class, 0);
142    int yearMonthCount = typeCounts.getOrDefault(IYearMonthDurationItem.class, 0);
143    int numericCount = typeCounts.getOrDefault(INumericItem.class, 0);
144
145    IAnyAtomicItem retval;
146    if (dayTimeCount > 0) {
147      if (dayTimeCount != count) {
148        throw new InvalidArgumentFunctionException(
149            InvalidArgumentFunctionException.INVALID_ARGUMENT_TYPE,
150            String.format("Values must all be of type '%s'.", IDayTimeDurationItem.class.getName()));
151      }
152
153      retval = items.stream()
154          .map(item -> (IDayTimeDurationItem) item)
155          .reduce((item1, item2) -> OperationFunctions.opAddDayTimeDurations(
156              ObjectUtils.notNull(item1),
157              ObjectUtils.notNull(item2)))
158          .get();
159    } else if (yearMonthCount > 0) {
160      if (yearMonthCount != count) {
161        throw new InvalidArgumentFunctionException(
162            InvalidArgumentFunctionException.INVALID_ARGUMENT_TYPE,
163            String.format("Values must all be of type '%s'.", IYearMonthDurationItem.class.getName()));
164      }
165
166      retval = items.stream()
167          .map(item -> (IYearMonthDurationItem) item)
168          .reduce((item1, item2) -> OperationFunctions.opAddYearMonthDurations(
169              ObjectUtils.notNull(item1),
170              ObjectUtils.notNull(item2)))
171          .get();
172    } else if (numericCount > 0) {
173      if (numericCount != count) {
174        throw new InvalidArgumentFunctionException(
175            InvalidArgumentFunctionException.INVALID_ARGUMENT_TYPE,
176            String.format("Values must all be of type '%s'.", INumericItem.class.getName()));
177      }
178
179      retval = items.stream()
180          .map(item -> (INumericItem) item)
181          .reduce((item1, item2) -> OperationFunctions.opNumericAdd(
182              ObjectUtils.notNull(item1),
183              ObjectUtils.notNull(item2)))
184          .get();
185    } else {
186      throw new InvalidArgumentFunctionException(
187          InvalidArgumentFunctionException.INVALID_ARGUMENT_TYPE,
188          String.format("Values must all be of type '%s'.",
189              OperationFunctions.aggregateMathTypes().stream()
190                  .map(Class::getName)
191                  .collect(CustomCollectors.joiningWithOxfordComma(","))));
192    }
193
194    // resume CPD analysis - CPD-ON
195
196    return retval;
197  }
198}
